info.description: Updates the authenticated user's specified task list.
info.title: Google Tasks API

requests.description: Clears all completed tasks from the specified task list. The affected tasks will be marked as 'hidden' and no longer be returned by default when retrieving all tasks for a task list.
requests.name: POST /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/clear
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns all tasks in the specified task list.
requests.name: GET /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/tasks
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new task on the specified task list.
requests.name: POST /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/tasks
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the specified task from the task list.
requests.name: DELETE /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/tasks/{task}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/tasks/{task}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the specified task. This method supports patch semantics.
requests.name: PATCH /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/tasks/{task}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: PUT /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/tasks/{task}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Moves the specified task to another position in the task list. This can include putting it as a child task under a new parent and/or move it to a different position among its sibling tasks.
requests.name: POST /tasks/v1/lists/{tasklist}/tasks/{task}/move
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns all the authenticated user's task lists.
requests.name: GET /tasks/v1/users/@me/lists

requests.description: Creates a new task list and adds it to the authenticated user's task lists.
requests.name: POST /tasks/v1/users/@me/lists

requests.description: Deletes the authenticated user's specified task list.
requests.name: DELETE /tasks/v1/users/@me/lists/{tasklist}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /tasks/v1/users/@me/lists/{tasklist}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the authenticated user's specified task list. This method supports patch semantics.

requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_TASKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
